<thought>Based on the molecular formula (C9H10O5Br), the NMR data showing six aromatic carbons and two aliphatic carbons, and the absence of carbonyls or methyl groups, the most logical way to split the molecule is into a brominated phenyl fragment and a highly oxygenated three‑carbon fragment. Their SMILES are:

- Bromophenyl fragment: Brc1ccccc1  
- Oxygen‑rich aliphatic fragment: C(CO)(CO)O

These two fragments together contain all the atoms of the original compound and can be joined via a carbon‑carbon bond.</thought>
<final_answer>['Brc1ccccc1', 'C(CO)(CO)O']</final_answer>
